title: Pocketwire Rewards Redemption Rate Card and Partner Charities
content:
Pocketwire Rewards points are valued by tier at the rates below, stated in US cents per point, for cash to the personal balance, digital gift cards and partner charity donations.

| Tier | Cash to personal balance (cents per point) | Digital gift card (cents per point) | Partner charity donation (cents per point) | Pocketwire matching donation (percent of donation value) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Rewards Member | 0.80 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Silver | 0.90 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Gold | 1.00 | 1.10 | 1.00 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Platinum | 1.00 | 1.15 | 1.25 | 5 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Diamond | 1.10 | 1.25 | 1.25 | 10 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian | 1.25 | 1.50 | 1.50 | 25 |

The matching donation is the percentage of a charity redemption's donation value that Pocketwire adds as a matching donation of its own. A matching percentage of 0 means Pocketwire adds no matching donation on that tier.

## Partner charities available for charity redemptions

| Tier | Partner charities |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Rewards Member | Feeding America, American Red Cross |
| Pocketwire Rewards Silver | Feeding America, American Red Cross |
| Pocketwire Rewards Gold | Feeding America, American Red Cross, St. Jude Children's Research Hospital |
| Pocketwire Rewards Platinum | Feeding America, American Red Cross, St. Jude Children's Research Hospital |
| Pocketwire Rewards Diamond | Feeding America, American Red Cross, St. Jude Children's Research Hospital, World Wildlife Fund |
| Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian | Feeding America, American Red Cross, St. Jude Children's Research Hospital, World Wildlife Fund |

## Reading the card

- St. Jude Children's Research Hospital appears from Gold upward; World Wildlife Fund appears on Diamond and Obsidian only.
- On Gold a point is worth 1.00 cent as cash and 1.10 cents as a gift card; on Obsidian 1.25 cents as cash and 1.50 cents as a gift card or a donation.
